body.text: A reach audit found the wrist reward itself encourages an infeasible approach. Across the fixed 64 CPU starts, the uncalibrated frame-73 waypoint has median IK error 66.08 mm and only 3/64 satisfy 10 mm and 0.05 rad. The fitted pinch geometry gives 64/64 and median error 0.31 mm with a fixed palm-frame correction. Applying that correction throughout destroys reachability late, so the proposed reward fades it out across frames 130 to 148. The blended waypoints are reachable in 64/64 at frames 73 to 140, 61/64 at frame 149 and 43/64 at frame 162, versus 3/64 to 56/64 at the early frames, 56/64 and 35/64 at the last two. The object references stay reconstructed; the pool then selects by start heading as well as position. This is a wrist reward correction prepared for after the active budgets. See experiment/media/reference_alignment.json.

r0034 rejected the palm-history ablation. Candidate had 3/32 lifts in the initial sample, 4 candidate-only lifts versus zero incumbent-only on 96 paired draws (p=0.0625), zero full success, and two paired hardware violations versus zero. I reviewed both failure montages. In seed 209181378 at 2.30 s the digits bracket the housing but by 10 s there is a visible gap; the trace reports no unsupported opposition and 10.2 mm rise. In seed 493618404 the housing tilts under the finger and stays supported, later leaving the grasp region; trace reports 60.75 s of environment contact and no airborne grip. The mask improved interaction but did not reliably sustain a pinch. An updated training-only acquisition reward also preserves the starting blade posture through the pinch so table-assisted tipping does not qualify. Benchmarked on matched physical commands, 24/24 still qualified for the reward lift; mean return +29.12 versus hold -0.79 and random -2.18. No task criteria or frozen evaluator changes. Continue the active budgets.

body.text: The 2 ms diagnostic replay reproduced all 25 limit failures of the placement checkpoint in r0083. Fourteen first crossings affect middle MCP2, all below its -0.300 rad lower limit. At 14 of 25 first crossings there is no normal force above 0.1 N on a hand contact, while at nine crossings the plug touches a hand link. Crossing velocities reach 31.7 rad/s even with issued targets in spec. Several involve the finger snapping through rapidly after prior loads. Carrying eligibility continues to improve while late forced manipulation stays risky. Plan testable action stability or limit-margin shaping only after active branch budgets, with frozen CPU v2 comparisons. Evidence is experiment/ppo_evaluations/place78m/limit_crossings.json.

The 81.20M carry checkpoint now has ten qualifying supported releases in 64 CPU starts. The first split from hand contact near support, inside the zone and with blades up, occurs at 0.145–0.325 m/s linear speed and 0.71–7.66 rad/s spinning across these ten traces. All ten recontact on the next 60 Hz sample. One of the ten, seed 8173537, eventually rests for 1.05 s and is then moved away. A useful follow-up after the carry budget tests supported transfer with bounded approach speed before contact and a settled support dwell before opening. r0078 gate shows absence of leftward carry, so keep carry shaping when testing this distinction.

Acquisition has completed its planned 40M-step run at 40,059,027. The last 11,367 stochastic full starts registered zero opposed acquisition, lifts or turns, with 1,051 limit violations and 369 stops. Full CPU evaluation is in progress. GPU 3 starts a 36M-step weighted transport reset test from the 75,139,084-step PPO parent in r0077, checkpoint SHA-256 51d53553130c…. The parent completed one valid whole episode on 64 CPU starts. r0078 montages show repeated turning short of the goal. The test bundles the carry and settling rewards already measured separately with the long-episode fraction 0.35, the task palm box and r0081 training-only physically settled resets. The mid fraction begins near 0.42 and decays to 0.24 over the budget, with phases weighted 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.35, 0.30. Predictor: more clean supported releases and fewer recontacts on the original full, fresh-start contract-v3 distribution. All actor and critic weights come from the same random-initialized PPO lineage. The reset pool includes joint and object states but no actions. Continue the existing carry, placement and long-horizon comparisons through their own budgets.

body.text: The r0124 release audit matches a qualifying release in each of 12 partial carry episodes. The first openings happen at 0.089–0.148 m/s and 0.83–5.44 rad/s, with all 12 recontacting on the next 60 Hz sample. Seed 8173551 later has two intervals of upright rest in the goal, the longest 14.017–25.383 s. It keeps the plug steady at (0.3530, -0.0137, -0.2935) m, withdraws, then torque-halts with no plug contact while the plug is still at rest. The halt at 20.126 Nm and a limit excursion of 0.05031 rad exclude success. This shows that settling and post-release hardware stability both need evaluation.
